description: Run one calculator by id with numeric inputs: every key from list_calculators, exactly as listed, in the listed units (an unknown or missing key is an error naming it; nothing takes a default). Returns every result with its unit, the formula, the Given → Formula → Substitute → Result working when the engine can derive it, and the URL of the solved page.

calculator_id.description: The calculator id (slug) from list_calculators, e.g. kinetic-energy

inputs.description: Every input key from list_calculators (e.g. {"m": 2, "v": 3}), in the listed units; an unknown or missing key is an error

name: calculate
title: Run a calculator
